readout_row_law.note: backing z greater = farther, digits z smaller = closer = on top (r158 z physics); row width derives from the LIVE digit count (dynamic sizing, no pinned width)

readout.mount_note: population beacon floats above the data conduit band (band top 13.667 + 0.175 clearance; below the star field 16.271); the S5 street life (EAVE-N01 body top 11.667, ResN02) stays far below

wall_slots.reading_order_to_wall: slot i <-> census.wall[i] (wall[0] = newest = highest id, r165 frontier law)
wall_slots.lit_law: slot i lights iff census.wall[i] exists; alpha = 235 if i == 0 (newest card) else 160; census section missing -> every overlay off (grandfather: baked art is authored vocabulary, never a fake live state)
wall_slots.slot_art_rects_note: bake-lab-glass.ps1 r185 canon: inner lit core 3x2 px per 5x4 slot, cols @(7,13) rows @(48,53,58); reading order = row-major from the top-left newest slot (the baked-lit (0,0) slot)

ceremony.note: cabin-print pulse: chamber glow + newest card burst; TriggerDirect injection in proof mode (r115 precedent), live tail-cursor trigger in play

readout.mount_note: center pinned 0.1u east of the sandbox axis so the 3-digit cap clears B1's east wall (x=-6): cap west edge -5.939, margin 0.061u; ResN01 body east stays 0.69u clear; live 2-digit rows sit further inside

poll.state_source: world/world-state.json (read-only, P-43 single-writer law; CityStreetBehavior r124 precedent)
poll.event_source: world/world-events.jsonl tail read with a line cursor; cursor beyond line count after the daily rotation -> reset to 0 (r3 self-check law)
poll.grandfather: census section missing -> birth readout hidden + all wall overlays off; evolution section missing -> sandbox readout hidden; facility sprites stay as authored (honest fallback, zero fake numbers)
poll.note: the sandbox is the only LIVE face (D-02); the birth station is half-alive: wall + total always on, the ceremony waits for a real birth event (never a timer)

rejected.runtime_cjk_on_wall_cards: engine has no runtime CJK text path (r17 deferred line; all city text is pre-baked GDI+) - at 1u scale a card is 5x4 art px anyway; cards render as LIT PRESENCE, names stay in state.census.wall for data consumers
rejected.sandbox_total_or_applied_readout: the sandbox is the CITY FUTURE face: open proposals (19) is the future-facing count; applied (27) lands as the canon pulse + closed history, total (103) mixes closed rows - neither reads as 'future'
rejected.tier_alpha_on_readouts: displays are emitted light, the sign family law (neon stays on through the night tint); constant alpha, ambient tint applies to the readout like every world object
rejected.baked_wall_numbers: any number baked into a sprite would go stale (D-02 stale honesty law) - the digits asset carries glyphs only, every value is read live each poll

honest_notes: the birth readout floats above the conduit band - a census beacon on the data pipe (census flows west to the tower, the count shines above it); mount swept vs band/PV1/street life in the r188 gate
wall overlays are additive presence on top of the baked 2-lit art: the baked lit slots are authored vocabulary, the runtime overlays are the live layer (all six light when six wall cards exist)
star field (y16.271+), horizon band (y16.75+) and every light layer (bloom/cone/wet) sit clear of both readouts by y-band; light layers are report-only per the r169 A4b law
